decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) The rear wing specification has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Articles 28.2 and 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The Power Unit elements used are in excess of the permitted number for the 2024 Championship season were used. This is a breach of Art. 28.2 and incurs a grid penalty. Additionally, Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber Team changed the rear wing assembly of Car 77 under Parc Ferme with the approval of the Technical Delegate in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. However, the assembly is of a different specification, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 77 is required to start the Race from pit lane. Due to the fact that the car is required to start from the pit lane, the grid penalty does not come into effect.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 77 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
